---
description: "Use when editing a knowledge base folder: semantic.yaml, knowledge_graph.yaml, memories.jsonl, generated docs and catalog."
applyTo: "kb/**"
---
# Knowledge base folders (`kb/<name>/`)

| File | Edit by hand? | How it changes |
|---|---|---|
| `catalog.json` | no | `sqlmem scan` (facts from the database) |
| `semantic.yaml` | yes | curated business meaning; validate with `sqlmem build` (warnings list unknown tables/columns) |
| `knowledge_graph.yaml` | yes, carefully | `sqlmem graph` / MCP `save_knowledge_graph`; re-verify with `sqlmem graph --kb <kb> --check --db <db>` |
| `memories.jsonl` | no | `sqlmem remember` / MCP `remember`, removed with `forget` |
| `docs/`, `graph.json` | no | regenerated by `sqlmem build` |
| `index.db` | never commit | derived search index, rebuilt by `sqlmem build` |

- After changing `semantic.yaml`, `knowledge_graph.yaml` or memories, run `sqlmem build --kb <kb>` and commit the
  regenerated docs in the same change.
- `kb/adventureworks2025` is the evaluation fixture: run `python -m evals.run_retrieval --ablate-kg` (and with
  `--embedder kb`) and report the numbers in the evidence record.
- Knowledge-graph edits must keep every relation verified (`verified:` block present). Unverified or dropped items
  are reported by `--check`; fix them or explain them in the evidence record.
